original_title: Sterling Expands ADC Manufacturing Capacity in the UK - Chemical Industry Digest
title: Sterling adds ADC manufacturing capacity in the UK
blurb: Sterling is expanding its antibody-drug conjugate manufacturing capacity in the UK, capacity for a drug class that's been outrunning the contract manufacturers that make it.

original_title: Planar Dinuclear Copper-Based Hydrogen-Bonded Organic Framework with Synergy Catalysis for High-Performance Hydroboration of Alkynes
title: A copper HOF that hydroborates alkynes before your coffee gets cold
blurb: Cu-PzDC, a hydrogen-bonded organic framework built from planar dinuclear copper units, pushes terminal alkyne hydroboration to complete conversion in 30 minutes at room temperature. The dinuclear-copper teamwork angle is apparently rare for this reaction, which is the actual claim here, not just another HOF catalyst paper.

original_title: Inside Front Cover: “Armor Polymerization” Unlocks Polymer Electrolytes With Simultaneous Rapid Li + Conduction and High Solidification
title: An armor trick for polymer electrolytes that conduct fast and solidify hard
blurb: Inside-cover piece on an "armor polymerization" approach that gets polymer electrolytes to combine rapid Li+ conduction with high solidification at once, two properties that usually trade off against each other in solid-state electrolytes.
